limits: A fragment the calibrating curve cannot place is counted, not drawn.
bio.jane/contract.question: Where does each lane's fragments run on an agarose gel against the marker ladder?

description: Run an agarose gel and photograph it: every lane's fragments migrated by the validated pydna model, drawn as a gel-doc image with the marker ladder's bp marks and each lane's name. The same plate the gel panels draw, so the figure and the rail put every fragment in the same place. Wire `fragments` from a digest or `lengths` from an assembly into `lanes`. A fragment the calibrating curve cannot place is COUNTED in `offScale`, never drawn at the well.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

agarose_percent.description: the gel's agarose (% w/v). Set it and migration comes from a concentration law instead of the ladder's own spline, so the gel responds to the percentage the way a real one does; leave it unset for the ladder-calibrated placement. In %.

caption.description: the line under the plate naming the curve that positioned the bands and what their brightness is relative to. Advanced.

dna_form.description: topology of the sample DNA: supercoiled and nicked circles do not migrate where a linear fragment of the same length does. Only the Helling-Goodman-Boyer law uses it. Values: linear (Linear), supercoiled (Supercoiled), nicked (Nicked), relaxed (Relaxed). Only applies when agarose_percent is set. Advanced.

exposure.description: Whole plate: brightness against the brightest band on the plate (a lightly loaded lane, the ladder included, can draw almost black); Per lane: brightness against each lane's own brightest band (brightness can no longer be compared between lanes). Values: plate (Whole plate), lane (Per lane).

labels.description: print the ladder's readable bp marks, each lane's number above its well and a legend naming it. Off gives the bare plate, for a figure that captions itself.

ladder.description: the MW marker in the reference lane, which is also the curve every lane's migration is read off unless `agarose_percent` is set. Values: generuler_1kb_plus (GeneRuler 1 kb Plus (75–20,000)), hi_lo (Hi-Lo DNA Marker (50–10,000)), generuler_1kb (GeneRuler 1 kb (250–10,000)), generuler_100bp (GeneRuler 100 bp (100–3,000)), generuler_100bp_plus (GeneRuler 100 bp Plus (100–3,000)), thermo_1kb_plus (Thermo 1 Kb Plus (100–15,000)), neb_1kb (NEB 1 kb (500–10,000)), neb_100bp (NEB 100 bp (100–1,517)), lambda_hindiii (Lambda DNA / HindIII (125–23,130)), penn_state (PennState (500–10,000)).

lane_width.description: how wide each lane is drawn. In px. Advanced.

lanes.description: the lanes, each {name, lengths: [bp, …]}. The marker lane is added for you — `ladder` chooses it.

mobility_model.description: which published mobility law the agarose % is applied through. Ignored unless `agarose_percent` is set. Values: helling-goodman-boyer (Helling-Goodman-Boyer), rill-van-winkle (Rill / Van Winkle). Only applies when agarose_percent is set. Advanced.

stain.description: the dye the plate was stained with; its published emission maximum is the colour the bands are drawn in. Values: etbr (Ethidium bromide), sybr-safe (SYBR Safe), sybr-gold (SYBR Gold), gelred (GelRed).

name: draw_gel

bandCount.description: bands with a position on this plate — what the picture shows

calibratedBy.description: the (bp, Rf) curve that positioned every lane

ladder.description: the marker in the reference lane

laneCount.description: sample lanes drawn, the marker lane excluded

offScale.description: fragments the curve could not place, so they are NOT on the picture — check this before reading a lane as complete

svg.description: the gel as an SVG figure, carrying the photographed plate and its labels
